Model Formula

Fitting function: glmmTMB

Error structure / family: Gamma(link = "log")

Estimation method: ML

Formula:

Biomass ~ Method + log10(Chl) + ns(Bathy, df = 2) + harmonic(HarmDOY, 
    k = 1) + Mesh + harmonic(HarmTOD, k = 1) * Depth_decay + 
    (1 | Gear)

2 · Model Diagnostics

Posterior predictive check, linearity, homogeneity of variance, influential observations, normality of residuals, normality of random effects.

Note on the Posterior Predictive Check: The x-axis is on a log₁₀ scale because the response (Biomass) spans several orders of magnitude. The simulated density lines (light) should closely track the observed line (dark) — if they do, the model captures the distribution of the data well.
